answer_q: What is an AI voice agent?
answer: An AI voice agent is software that speaks and listens on the phone like a trained staff member. It uses speech recognition and a large language model to understand the caller, follows the rules you set, takes actions such as booking or updating records, and hands the call to a person when needed.
body:
What AI voice agents are used for

Phone work is still where many Australian businesses lose the most time. Reminder calls, quote follow-ups and “just checking in” calls are important, but they take hours and are easy to skip on a busy day. An AI voice agent makes and takes those calls consistently, at the times you choose, and records exactly what happened.

Outbound calls

  • Appointment reminders and confirmations a day or two before, with easy rescheduling on the same call.
  • Quote follow-ups that ask whether the customer has questions and book a site visit or call back.
  • Lead qualification for new web enquiries, asking your screening questions and booking qualified leads into a sales call.
  • Customer check-ins after a job or service, collecting feedback and flagging unhappy customers to a manager.
  • Payment reminders that are polite and consistent, with a link sent by SMS.

Inbound calls

For answering your business line, booking appointments and transferring urgent calls, see our dedicated AI receptionist. Voice agents also handle inbound support lines, order status enquiries and after-hours overflow.

How an AI voice agent call works

  1. The agent introduces itself, names your business and says it is an AI assistant.
  2. It follows a conversation plan you approve, but responds naturally to what the person actually says.
  3. It looks up or updates information in your CRM, calendar or job system during the call.
  4. It confirms the outcome, sends an SMS or email if needed, and ends the call politely.
  5. It logs a summary, transcript and outcome tag, such as “booked”, “call back” or “not interested”.
  6. Anything outside its rules is transferred to a person or queued for a callback.

Voice agents tuned for Australian callers

Generic voice bots often sound foreign, mishear local place names and get dates wrong. We configure Australian English voices, local phone numbers, Australian date, time and address formats, public holidays and calling hours that suit your customers. We test with real accents and noisy environments, such as callers on a job site or in the car.

Rules for responsible calling

Outbound calling in Australia has rules, and customers expect honesty. Every voice agent we build discloses that it is an AI, identifies your business, respects opt-outs and calls only within the hours you set. We work with you to make sure your calling lists, consent and scripts suit Australian requirements, including the Do Not Call Register where it applies, and we keep a full record of every call.

Data handling follows the Privacy Act 1988 and the OAIC’s AI product guidance. The agent only accesses the customer details it needs for that call.

What results to expect

Voice agents pay back fastest where calls are frequent, repetitive and currently skipped. Before we build, we measure how many calls your team makes, how long they take and how many are missed. After launch, the monthly report shows calls completed, outcomes, transfers and hours returned to your team. Use our savings calculator for a quick estimate.

How we build your voice agent

  1. Free AI audit: we pick the call type with the best payback and lowest risk.
  2. Conversation design: we draft the script, questions, objection handling and handover rules with your team.
  3. Integration: we connect your phone system, CRM and calendar.
  4. Testing: internal test calls, then a small pilot list of real customers.
  5. Launch and review: full rollout with monthly call reviews and improvements.

Voice is one of several AI agents we build. For website and messaging conversations, see AI chatbot development.
faqs: What is the difference between an AI voice agent and an AI receptionist?

An AI receptionist answers your incoming business calls and books appointments. An AI voice agent is broader: it can also make outbound calls such as reminders, quote follow-ups and lead qualification, and handle dedicated support lines.
Do AI voice agents sound natural?

Modern voice agents sound close to a person and respond to interruptions and follow-up questions. We use Australian English voices and test with local accents, but we always disclose that the caller is speaking with an AI.
Is it legal to use AI for outbound calls in Australia?

AI calling is used in Australia, but the same rules apply as for human calls, including consent, calling hours, identification and the Do Not Call Register where relevant. We design scripts and call lists with these requirements in mind.
Can the voice agent update our CRM during a call?
Yes. The agent can look up customer details, check availability, book appointments and log outcomes in CRMs such as HubSpot, Zoho and GoHighLevel while the call is happening.
